subject: Feature Enablement Notice for SAP Business Network - Enhancements to Relationship Management User Interface (EVB5061062)
body:
SAP Communication

 

Release Readiness Communication for SAP Business Network

 

Feature Enablement Notice for SAP Business Network - Enhancements to Relationship Management User Interface

 

 

Hello,

Starting September 21, 2024, users will begin to see the new Enhancements to Relationship Management User Interface [NP-45779] feature enabled in their SAP Business Network portal.

Announced with the SAP Business Network 2405 release, this feature introduces a new user experience to the following pages:

  • Current Relationships under Supplier Enablement for buyers
  • Customer Relationships under Account Settings for suppliers


The updated pages provide a streamlined user interface with enhanced user experience to manage relationships on SAP Business Network. Learn more about the Enhancements to Relationship Management User Interface feature with the following resources.

  • What’s New guide (2405 release)
  • Feature Overview

Note: The new experience has a subset of capabilities compared to the legacy interface. The legacy interface can be accessed by clicking Advanced View. Actions moved from the legacy interface are only available in the new interface.

Look for the language option at the top right of the page to view translated versions of this notice. Please do not reply to this email as this mailbox is not monitored.


Thank you,
Release Readiness | SAP Business Network


IMPORTANT NOTE
This notice reflects SAP Business Network planning as of the date of this notice. Nothing in this notice should be construed to represent any commitment by SAP Business Network to include any specific new features in any version of SAP solutions. All dates in this communication are based on US Pacific Time.
